//: A REAL typecheck for the flight modules, because the claimed one was not.
`bunx tsc --noEmit -p .` in a repo with no root tsconfig prints TS5081 and
EXITS 0 -- so a grep over its output found no flight errors and 'clean
typecheck' got reported for a command that never checked a file. mica
caught it; this file is what makes the claim checkable.
Scoped to the flight modules on purpose. The repo is no-build plain JS +
JSDoc (shared/README.md) and is not globally clean under checkJs; a
whole-repo config would either drown these files in unrelated errors or
have to be loosened until it proved nothing.
